mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, ITEM_ID AS itemId, MARKET_NAME AS marketName, BASE_DATE AS baseDate, PRICE AS price FROM PRICE_MARKET WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY BASE_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT ID AS id, ITEM_ID AS itemId, MARKET_NAME AS marketName, BASE_DATE AS baseDate, PRICE AS price FROM PRICE_DAILY WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND BASE_DATE = #{baseDate}
SELECT ID AS id, ITEM_ID AS itemId, MARKET_NAME AS marketName, BASE_DATE AS baseDate, PRICE AS price FROM PRICE_MARKET WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY BASE_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRICE_MARKET ( ITEM_ID, MARKET_NAME, BASE_DATE, PRICE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{marketName}, #{baseDate}, #{price} )
INSERT INTO PRICE_DAILY ( ITEM_ID, MARKET_NAME, BASE_DATE, PRICE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{marketName}, #{baseDate}, #{price} )
INSERT INTO PRICE_FETCH_LOG ( FETCHED_AT, FETCHED_COUNT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{fetchedAt}, #{fetchedCount}, #{status}, #{errorMessage} )
